title: Support of a Pauli string built from prescribed data
statement: Fix $n$, a finset $S \subseteq \mathrm{Fin}\,n$, and an assignment $f : S \to \{X,Y,Z\}$ of a non-identity Pauli to each coordinate in $S$. Let $p$ be the Pauli string of length $n$ that equals $f(i)$ at each $i \in S$ and equals the identity $I$ at every coordinate outside $S$. Then the support of $p$ — the set of coordinates where $p$ differs from $I$ — is exactly $S$.
hypotheses_covered: assignment f from S to non-identity Paulis
replaced: The Pauli string $\mathrm{mkWithSupport}\,S\,f$ has support exactly $S$.
